meta.name: golden-pptx
meta.description: Use when testing the pptx golden build

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证PPTX生成功能是否正常
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify PPTX generation works correctly

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查阅并引用一份名为 golden_pptx 的演示文稿内容,包括标题、作者、章节结构、代码示例、表格数据等,回答相关问题时基于这些材料作答。
howto.when: 当用户提到要测试 pptx golden build,或询问 golden_pptx 演示文稿的结构、代码示例、表格等细节时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看 golden_pptx 演示文稿里有哪些 Python 代码示例?
say.note: 会列出该文稿中的 Python 代码块。

say.text: golden_pptx 演示文稿的章节是怎么划分的?
say.note: 会给出总章节和各节标题。

say.text: 这个演示文稿的标题和作者是谁?
say.note: 会返回 The Deck 和 Jane Doe。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can access and cite content from a presentation named golden_pptx, including title, author, sections, code examples, tables, and use it when answering related questions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions testing the pptx golden build, or asks about the structure, code examples, tables, or other details of the golden_pptx presentation.

say_en.text: Can you list the Python code examples in the golden_pptx presentation?
How are the sections divided in the golden_pptx presentation?
What is the title and author of this presentation?
say_en.note: Returns The Deck and Jane Doe.
